items.text: The movie Star Wars, directed by George Lucas, was released on May 25, 1977, opening in 32 movie theaters across the United States.
items.question: Where did you first see Star Wars, and who did you go with?
items.source_quote: May 25 – The movie Star Wars, directed by George Lucas is released as the first film in the Star Wars Saga and the first in the Original Trilogy. It is premiered in 32 movie theaters across the United States before reaching other cinemas nationwide.

items.text: Debby Boone's "You Light Up My Life" reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in October 1977 and stayed there ten consecutive weeks, a new record for the longest unbroken run.
items.question: Where were you living when Debby Boone's "You Light Up My Life" was on the radio, and who in your house sang along?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1977, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations, respectively. During the year, 29 different singles spent time at number one.
In October, Debby Boone gained her first number one with "You Light Up My Life". The single occupied the top spot for ten consecutive weeks, setting new records for both the longest unbroken run

items.text: The Atari 2600, which played games from cartridges, was released in October 1977.
items.question: Who was the first person you knew with an Atari, and which game did everyone want to play?
items.source_quote: Atari 2600, released in October, popularized the use of microprocessor based hardware and cartridges containing game code.
